name: 76227 · Aubrey, TX
findings: ZIP 76227 (Aubrey) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76227 (Aubrey) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76227 (Aubrey) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
